dashboard.unrealizedDeltaTooltip: Change in unrealized gain/loss on positions still open.
dashboard.realizedSalesTooltip: Realized gain or loss from sales in the period, and from holdings handed over at a cost (for example to a broker LibreFolio does not track), calculated against average cost basis.
dashboard.incomeTooltip: Income received in the period from dividends, interest or coupons.
dashboard.marketValueTooltip: Current market value of your portfolio at end of period.
dashboard.bookValueTooltip: Average purchase cost of open positions (WAC × quantity). Excludes cash.
dashboard.cashValueTooltip: Total cash held in broker accounts.
dashboard.periodScopeNote: Metrics calculated over the selected period
dashboard.timingEffectTooltip: If positive, deposits and withdrawals happened at favorable times and improved your return compared to the pure strategy. If negative, they happened at unfavorable times.
dashboard.twrrTooltip:
Strategy return,
neutralizing deposits and withdrawals.
dashboard.mwrrCumTooltip:
Money-weighted return of the period,
considering amounts and timing of flows.
dashboard.mwrrAnnTooltip:
Annualized equivalent rate
of money-weighted return.
dashboard.geoUnclassified: Geographic data unavailable for {pct}% of portfolio value
dashboard.roiAllZero: Returns are 0% for the selected period
dashboard.periodPnlTooltip: Total gain or loss attributable to the selected period only (unrealized change + realized + income − fees). May differ from the position's total lifetime gain.
dashboard.pnlChange1dTooltip: Change in unrealized P&L versus yesterday, keeping today's quantity constant.
dashboard.pnlChange1dPercentTooltip: Daily unrealized P&L change as a percentage of yesterday's position market value. For a long position with unchanged quantity, this matches the daily price return.
dashboard.otherPeriodEffectsSubtitle: Effects that contribute to period P&L but are not linked to a specific asset
dashboard.unrealizedPnlPercentTooltip: Unrealized P&L as a percentage of the residual cost basis (Unrealized P&L / cost basis).
dashboard.pmcTooltip: Average cost per unit of the currently open position.
dashboard.oldestOpenLotDateTooltip: Opening date of the oldest FIFO lot still open for this position.
dashboard.annualizedReturnTooltip: Net annualized return (CAGR) of all still-open lots of this position, from the first transaction to today — including income minus fees; valued at cost when no market price. For comparison across positions held for different durations.
dashboard.annualizedReturnPeriodTooltip: Net annualized return (CAGR) over the position's holding window within the selected period, for comparison across periods of different durations.
dashboard.netWorthTooltip: Securities at market value + cash (+ value in transit). Includes liquidity — not comparable to the securities-only figure in a bank statement.
dashboard.yieldOnCostTooltip: Compares gross dividends and interest recorded over the last year with the average purchase price (WAC).
dashboard.yieldOnCostNoIncome: No dividends or interest in the last year.

yieldOnCostReasons.insufficientHistory: History at this broker is shorter than one year.
yieldOnCostReasons.incomeWithoutEligibleQuantity: A recorded payment has no quantity held on the previous day.
yieldOnCostReasons.replayInconsistent: Purchase, sale, or transfer history cannot be reconstructed correctly.
yieldOnCostReasons.invalidSplit: A linked split is inconsistent with the recorded quantities.
yieldOnCostReasons.missingFx: The exchange rate required for a payment is unavailable.
yieldOnCostReasons.missingWac: The average purchase price (WAC) is unavailable.
yieldOnCostReasons.nonPositiveWac: The average purchase price (WAC) is zero or negative.
yieldOnCostReasons.missingFxDetails: The {pair} exchange rate required for the calculation is missing on {date}.
yieldOnCostReasons.negativeNetIncome: Corrections exceed the income of the last year.

dashboard.pnlCandlesHypotheticalShort: Synthetic — cross-asset high/low are hypothetical and non-simultaneous
dashboard.startValueTooltip: The position's value at the start of the period, worked out as the Value column of the Portfolio; 0 if the position did not exist yet. It is the base of the period's percentages.
dashboard.endValueTooltip: The position's value at the end of the period, worked out as the Value column of the Portfolio; 0 if the position was already closed.
